class: A 'not found' or 'no screenshot' result read as the page's fault without a known-good comparison: the capture tool itself may be failing.
mechanism: Chrome screenshots time out after the first frame while page text still reads; the PC is not locked, the window is likely not drawing.

fix: Owner wakes the screen and brings the Chrome window to the front; compare with a page known to draw first.
